questions.question: In Star Wars, what does Han say he’s in it for, not the revolution?
questions.note: He takes Luke’s charter to pay off a debt. The rescue is not the plan.

questions.question: What is the name of Han Solo’s ship?
questions.note: Han pilots the Millennium Falcon with Chewbacca. The battered freighter first appears in the original Star Wars.

questions.question: In The Empire Strikes Back, what does Han say after Leia tells him “I love you”?
questions.note: Ford suggested the line. It stuck.

questions.question: Who kills Han Solo in Star Wars: The Force Awakens?
questions.note: Kylo Ren is Han and Leia’s son, Ben Solo. J.J. Abrams directed the 2015 film.

questions.question: What crime boss does Han Solo owe a lot of money to?
questions.note: That debt is why he takes Luke’s charter, and why he ends up in carbonite.

questions.question: In which 1973 George Lucas film did Harrison Ford get his first major role?
questions.note: He plays Bob Falfa, the cowboy-hatted racer in a black Chevy. Lucas then used him in Star Wars.

questions.question: In The Empire Strikes Back, what is Han frozen in before being handed to Jabba?
questions.note: Lando’s Cloud City facility. Leia, Chewie, and Lando spend Return of the Jedi getting him out.

questions.question: According to Han, the Millennium Falcon made the Kessel Run in less than how many parsecs?
questions.note: A parsec is a unit of distance, not time. Trivia nights still want twelve.

questions.question: Who is Han Solo’s Wookiee co-pilot?
questions.note: Chewbacca is Han’s longtime friend and co-pilot aboard the Millennium Falcon.

questions.question: In the original 1977 cantina scene, who shoots first?
questions.note: Later special editions reverse it. Trivia nights still want the 1977 answer: Han.
